arm_groups.label: met + glimepiride + pioglitazone placebo + albiglutide placebo

brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the safety and efficacy of albiglutide in subjects with type 2 diabetes
brief_title: A Study to Determine the Safety and Efficacy of Albiglutide in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* type 2 diabetes
* BMI 20-45kg/m2 inclusive

Exclusion Criteria:

* females who are pregnant, lactating, or less than 6 weeks post-partum
* current symptomatic heart failure (NYHA Class II-IV)

official_title: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo and Active-Controlled, Parallel-group, Multicenter Study to Determine the Efficacy and Safety of Albiglutide Administered in Combination With Metformin and Glimepiride Compared With Metformin Plus Glimepiride and Placebo and With Metformin Plus Glimepiride and Pioglitazone in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

primary_outcomes.measure: Change From Baseline (BL) in Glycosylated Hemoglobin (HbA1c) at Week 52
